purpose: Fused preactivation recompute in the R-tiled backward: qualify FUSE=1/2 (gradient gate against the FP64 oracle with FlashRNN1 calibration, persistent == launch bitwise, 20 repeats), race-verify and sanitize them, profile D = 384/512 at B = 16, then select among unfused (fast + TF32) and fused backward candidates per forward and time the training step against FlashRNN1 (TileLang env B = 16, module env B = 16 and 64) and fused against unfused
gates: Pre-registered admission of a fused level f to selection: every qualification case of level f passes (grads, modes, repeat; vs_base is not applicable: a fused kernel is not bitwise to the GEMM path by construction), the race 'correct' groups of level f are clean (0 violations, outputs bitwise equal to the uninstrumented kernel; broken-variant controls are reported, not gating), and every sanitizer run of level f reports 0 errors. A level that fails is removed from every selection role before selection; the unfused candidates (qualified in run [misquoted id]/fix confirmation) always stay.
criterion: Pre-registered: B = 16 counts as fixed if, in at least one environment, the selected FlashRNN2 training step (role frnn2 = unfused + admitted fused candidates)'s 95% interval lower bound against FlashRNN1 is >= 1.0 for every D in 192-768 and both cells; B = 64 must not regress (every shape keeps lower bound >= 1.0). The fusion effect is the fused-vs-unfused comparison (best admitted fused vs best unfused, same forward set) per shape. Default rule: fuse_pre becomes the default for a width D only if fused-vs-unfused has lower bound >= 1.0 at B = 16 in the TileLang environment for both cells; it applies to every batch size if the B = 64 fused-vs-unfused upper bound is >= 1.0 for both cells, otherwise only to B <= 16.

expected_minutes.basis: v3 (run fix confirmation) took 60 min for 28 prebuilds, 80 phase-0 tasks, 39 selections and 40 comparisons; here 20 prebuilds, about 200 phase-0 tasks plus 8 profiles, 30 selections with about twice the candidates, 60 comparisons x 5 starts

node_reason: One H100 node (4 H100): independent single-GPU lanes; no cross-GPU topology needed
